text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our Classic campaign begins this year. 
While watching TV partly to gather 
information—

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"Man... this year's Classic is shaping up 
to have quite an interesting lineup."

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"Sakura Bakushin O remains undefeated in 
Sprint races. And now Rice Shower has 
thrown her hat into the ring as well. 
However, naturally――"

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"Mihono Bourbon is one you can't overlook. 
After all, she's a future Triple Crown 
contender!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Mihono Bourbon's strength really does 
seem to be leagues above the other 
Umamusume who debuted last year."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Hello, Onii-sama.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Hello, Onee-sama.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah. It's Rice-o.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I just came to wish you a Happy New 
Year... Was I bothering you?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Come to think of it, Urara-chan 
was talking about that this morning.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Since it's the New Year, let's make 
resolu-shuns!" "...Are resolu-shuns 
tasty?" she said.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, that's true, isn't it? Rice said 
the exact same thing...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So... and then, um...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice was thinking... she'd like to come up 
with New Year's resolutions and goals for 
this year together with you, Big 
Brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice was thinking... she'd like to come up 
with New Year's resolutions and goals for 
this year together with you, Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Is that... a no?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Yay...! ...What should my goal be 
next?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Big Brother, what kind of goal are you 
setting?
choice_data_list: I'll make sure Rice catches up to Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...What kind of goal are you going to 
set, Big Sis?"
choice_data_list: I'll make sure Rice catches up to Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Onee-sama.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Can Rice make that her goal for this 
year too?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Then it's settled.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Rice will do her best so that both 
your dream and my dream can come true, 
Onii-sama."
choice_data_list: Take care of your body too, okay?

Let's make sure to learn everything we 
can!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Rice will do her best so that both 
your dream and my dream can come true, 
Onee-sama."
choice_data_list: Take care of your body too, okay?

Let's make sure to learn everything we 
can!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! It might be impossible at first, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Rice will definitely... never give up, 
okay?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And so, Rice Shower renewed her vow."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hawa... Catching a cold before the race 
would be awful, after all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if Rice takes a break, it'll mess 
up Big Brother's training schedule...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if Rice takes a break, it'll mess 
up Big Sister's training schedule...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Auuu...! I have to stay cheerful at all 
times...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her try to shoulder everything 
alone, I hurriedly stepped in to support 
her as we planned our next steps.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. You kind of sound like a 
teacher, Onii-sama.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. You kind of sound like a 
teacher, Onee-sama.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I'll be in your care for today's 
lesson as well... Sensei.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And together with Rice Shower, we watched 
race footage and studied Mihono Bourbon.
